+"""Request handlers."""
+
+from pathlib import Path
+
+from app.services import users
+
+_DATA_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2] / "data"
+
+
+def handle_get_user(params: dict) -> tuple[int, dict]:
+    raw = params.get("id")
+    if not isinstance(raw, str) or not raw.isdigit():
+        return 400, {"error": "invalid id"}
+    user = users.get_user(int(raw))
+    if user is None:
+        return 404, {"error": "not found"}
+    return 200, user
+
+
+def _parse_lines(value) -> int | None:
+    """Return the requested number of lines, or None when it is invalid."""
+    if not isinstance(value, str) or not value.isascii() or not value.isdigit():
+        return None
+    count = int(value)
+    if 1 <= count <= 100:
+        return count
+    return None
+
+
+def _resolve_data_file(path: str) -> Path | None:
+    """Resolve a relative data path, or None when it is invalid."""
+    segments = path.split("/")
+    if any(segment in ("", ".", "..") for segment in segments):
+        return None
+    return _DATA_DIR.joinpath(*segments)
+
+
+def handle_head_file(params: dict) -> tuple[int, dict]:
+    path = params.get("path")
+    if not isinstance(path, str) or not path:
+        return 400, {"error": "invalid request"}
+
+    file_path = _resolve_data_file(path)
+    count = _parse_lines(params.get("lines", "5"))
+    if file_path is None or count is None:
+        return 400, {"error": "invalid request"}
+
+    if not file_path.is_file():
+        return 404, {"error": "not found"}
+
+    text = file_path.read_bytes().decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
+
+    lines: list[str] = []
+    pieces = text.split("\n")
+    for index, piece in enumerate(pieces):
+        if index < len(pieces) - 1:
+            # This piece was terminated by "\n"; drop a trailing "\r" from "\r\n".
+            if piece.endswith("\r"):
+                piece = piece[:-1]
+            lines.append(piece)
+        elif piece != "":
+            # Final piece is a line only when it is not the remains of a trailing newline.
+            lines.append(piece)
+
+    return 200, {"lines": lines[:count]}
